title: The Kite Spar and the Drying Glue
youtube_title: The Kite Spar and the Drying Glue | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Chioma wants to check on a kite spar with a line of wet glue before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Chioma leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
